name: zenmoney-mcp
description: Access ZenMoney personal finance data — accounts, categories, transactions, transfers.
long_description: MCP server for ZenMoney. Sync data, browse categories and merchants, create and edit categories and simple accounts, list/filter transactions over arbitrary date ranges, add expenses/income, transfer between accounts (including cross-currency), edit, delete or restore existing transactions (one or many at once), and auto-suggest categories for known payees.

tools.name: sync_data
tools.description: Refresh data from ZenMoney now; other tools sync on their own.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List wallets, cards, and cash accounts.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List expense/income categories with hierarchy.

tools.name: add_category
tools.description: Create a category, optionally under a top-level parent; budget flags follow the shown sides.

tools.name: update_category
tools.description: Change a category's title, parent, visibility, budget flags or color.

tools.name: add_account
tools.description: Create a cash, ccard or checking account with an initial balance.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Change account metadata or a card credit limit; adjust balances with a correction transaction.

tools.name: list_merchants
tools.description: List known merchants/payees.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: List and filter transactions (supports arbitrary date ranges).

tools.name: add_expense
tools.description: Add an expense transaction.

tools.name: add_income
tools.description: Add an income transaction.

tools.name: add_transfer
tools.description: Transfer between accounts, including cross-currency.

tools.name: add_debt
tools.description: Record money lent, borrowed or repaid with a counterparty in the ordinary account currency.

tools.name: list_debts
tools.description: Show balances by counterparty and currency, without conversion; settled debts are hidden by default.

tools.name: update_transaction
tools.description: Change an existing transaction: category, amount, date, payee, comment or account.

tools.name: delete_transaction
tools.description: Delete one or more transactions by id, as the ZenMoney apps do.

tools.name: restore_transaction
tools.description: Bring deleted transactions back as copies with new ids.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List recurring and one-off plans with schedules and next planned dates.

tools.name: list_upcoming
tools.description: List planned operations for the next calendar days, sorted by date.

tools.name: add_reminder
tools.description: Plan an expense, income or transfer and create its dated markers.

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.description: Delete a series and its future planned markers, with confirmation.

tools.name: summarize_transactions
tools.description: Totals by category, payee, account or month in the main currency.

tools.name: get_budget
tools.description: A month's budget against actual expenses and income.

tools.name: set_budget
tools.description: Set or remove a month's planned expenses or income.

tools.name: suggest_category
tools.description: Suggest a category for a given payee.
